commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: A man boards the unsafe boat called begging, thinking it will carry him across the sea of poverty. If on the way it strikes the hard ground of hiding, it splits apart. What should be crossed by effort he tries to cross by begging, and he never sees the far shore. So don’t board it.
